 AMD Beats Q3 Estimates, Eyes Intel's Sales Lead—Can Chip Stocks Rally? 22.9M Views · 524 Posts Movers and Shakers joined discussion · Today's Pre-Market Movers and Top Ratings | SKHY, MU, SNDK and More
 Morning Movers Gapping Up $Vertiv Holdings (VRT.US)$ gained 16.51% in premarket trading after reporting Q3 results that beat estimates with net sales up 61 percent to 4.31 billion and adjusted EPS of 2.21 versus 1.83 expected and raising 2026 sales and EPS guidance. $GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC.US)$ increased 8.56% in premarket trading after lifting its full year profit outlook and posting Q3 results that beat expectations. $Amphenol (APH.US)$ increased 7.39% in premarket trading after reporting Q3 results that beat estimates and issuing fourth quarter revenue and EPS guidance above expectations and announcing a new 4 billion buyback and a 20 percent dividend increase. $SK hynix (SKHY.US)$ increased 7.35% in premarket trading after reporting record third quarter revenue and operating profit driven by AI memory demand and unveiling a seventy five billion dollar 2026 shareholder return program. $Eaton (ETN.US)$ climbed 4.39% in premarket trading after a Barrons report spotlighting 800V DC sidecar demand and a bullish BofA outlook on Eaton driven by accelerating AI data center power spending. $SanDisk (SNDK.US)$ climbed 4.15% in premarket trading after SK Hynix posted blockbuster results and outlined a major shareholder return plan boosting sentiment across memory chip stocks. $Micron Technology (MU.US)$ climbed 3.58% in premarket trading after SK Hynix reported record results and said memory demand will outpace supply through 2030 signaling sustained tight pricing for DRAM and high bandwidth memory. $NEBIUS (NBIS.US)$ climbed 3.55% in premarket trading after securing a 3.5 billion dollar credit facility from Citi to fund data center construction and GPU purchases. $CoreWeave (CRWV.US)$ climbed 3.33% in premarket trading after announcing new AI cloud capacity in Denmark and plans to expand into the Middle East and Asia. $Bloom Energy (BE.US)$ climbed 3.11% in premarket trading after Barclays raised its price target and Morgan Stanley highlighted Bloom Energy as a key beneficiary of rising AI driven power demand. Gapping Down $Enphase Energy (ENPH.US)$ tumbled 20.64% in premarket trading after reporting Q3 revenue and earnings misses and issuing Q4 sales guidance below estimates. $New Oriental (EDU.US)$ lost 13.69% in premarket trading due to adjusted EPS coming in below expectations alongside reaffirmed full year revenue guidance roughly in line with consensus and slight operating margin compression. $Boston Scientific (BSX.US)$ lost 12.34% in premarket trading after cutting full year sales and adjusted EPS guidance and forecasting a fourth quarter organic revenue decline of one to three percent due to cyberattack disruptions. $NXP Semiconductors (NXPI.US)$ dropped 8.09% in premarket trading after issuing weaker than expected fourth quarter revenue and GAAP EPS guidance. $F5 Inc (FFIV.US)$ dropped 7.29% in premarket trading after reporting fiscal Q4 results and issuing fiscal Q1 adjusted EPS guidance with a midpoint below estimates. $Robinhood (HOOD.US)$ dropped 6.62% in premarket trading after reporting Q3 revenue slightly below expectations and announcing it will stop new sports event contracts in Ohio amid a cease and desist order.
